v0.12.0 Update
- Added shared Actor Metrics support for D&D5e, PF2e, and generic systems.
- This version is required by the latest Stylish Action HUD stat tracking.
- Update GlitchSmith Library to restore tracked attributes and the full PF2e suggested value-path list, then reload your world.

announcement.title: 🔔 GlitchSmith Library v0.12.0
announcement.content:
Please update GlitchSmith Library to v0.12.0 if you use the latest Stylish Action HUD.

  • This update adds the Actor Metrics API required for tracked attributes.
  • PF2e users will regain the full suggested value-path list.
  • Reload your world after updating.
